issues: Results section 5 contradicts itself: it first says neither abstract reports unique patient/admission counts, then immediately says the abstracts give cohort sizes of 3,726 and 1,300 patients.

The delivery uses and cites as full-text sources PROBAST+AI (PMID 40127903) and the eICU descriptor (PMID 30204154), which are not among the three sources supplied in the brief, so those claims fall outside the designated source set and cannot be verified from the input.
judge.rationale: The delivery answers the brief: it inventories the two model publications, records them as abstract-level evidence, refuses to treat shared database use as proof of overlap or independence, states overlap unresolved, and explains the dates, identifiers, and eligibility definitions needed. Derived estimates are clearly marked with inputs and assumptions, and the practical section avoids clinical advice on derived figures. Minor defects: an internal contradiction about cohort-size reporting and reliance on two extra sources not supplied in the brief.
